TypeParameters.Name: Description
TypeParameters.Value: Crane F614 GEM Butterfly Valves are compact, lightweight units with a nitrile liner. Key Features: Aluminum Bronze Disk Nitrile Liner, Stainless steel shaft, Temperature operating range -10 to 82 degrees C, Lockable trigger lever. Valves are suitable for use with flanges conforming to BSEN1092-2 PN10 or PN16
